concepts.rationale: Familiar restaurant/home appetizer. Plain Romanian definition explains the borrowed name through toasted bread and toppings; distinct from a generic sandwich and from bare toast.
A plainly named baked bread dessert, with milk/egg soaking and baking defined. Recognition is supported by the familiar component words even for a player who has not cooked it.
Descriptive extension of familiar pancakes. Definition explains gratination through filled pancakes, sauce and oven browning, so the culinary term does not require prior specialist knowledge.
Recognizable Romanian home dessert with an honest broad definition covering potato and scalded dough. Fruit filling, boiling and sweet crumbs distinguish it from other dumplings.
Common borrowed menu term for a cold blended milk drink. Description explains it in Romanian and admits both ice-cream and fruit variants without claiming a traditional Romanian origin.
Recognizable layered baked dish with a definition broad enough for slices and mash. A strong distinct culinary payoff for minced meat and potatoes.
Familiar appetizer with an immediately descriptive Romanian name. Definition explicitly begins with boiled egg halves and yolk filling, matching both recipes.
Everyday ingredient with a useful role: drying/crushing bread and coating schnitzel. Definition distinguishes it from existing Firimitură and prevents a low-value synonym addition.
Ordinary recognizable dish, explicitly cooled/dressed. Defined preparation distinguishes it from the existing hot pasta dishes; grilled vegetables get a useful second role.
Very familiar soup named by its distinguishing ingredient. Thin noodles and optional poultry/vegetables define it clearly; no new specialist ingredient is forced.

items.rationale: Already toasted bread plus tomato strongly suggests bruschetta. Garlic and oil topping are disclosed; source concept toast keeps its prepared state.

Untoasted bread provides a forgiving alternative entry to the same appetizer. Toasting is explicitly performed before topping; no stale prepared-state assumption. It is slightly broader than the toast route but still inferable.
Bread with milk is a recognizable foundation for baked bread pudding. Egg, sugar, soaking and baking are explicit. This is a named reuse of bread rather than an arbitrary new bread synonym.

Raisins provide a plausible sweet-bread-pudding direction and a distinct route from milk. Mandatory milk/egg mixture and baking are disclosed. Less direct than bread plus milk, but legitimate optional experimentation rather than a forced path.

The oven is a strong operational clue for gratinated pancakes. Text states that pancakes are filled and sauced before gratinating; this is a preparation sequence within the established two-item abstraction.
Pancakes plus sour cream plausibly lead to an oven-finished version. Cheese filling, egg sauce and browning are named, so the existing plain pancake state is genuinely reused.

Plums and potato dough identify familiar gomboți. Potato preparation, flour binding, wrapping, boiling and sweet crumbs are explicit, avoiding the misleading idea that raw potato plus fruit alone becomes dessert.

The optional scalded-dough route is less obvious than potato but purposeful and consistent with the current Aluat opărit definition. Semolina/flour/egg formulation and boiling distinguish dumpling dough from simply baking choux pastry.

Banana plus milk is an approachable alternative drink pairing. Cold mixing is disclosed; this is a flavored milk drink, with no competing smoothie label in the world. Source-repair text must remain consistent with the final preparation.
Ice cream mixed with milk is a very legible cold-drink transformation and gives ice cream onward use. Mixing and optional fruit are explicit; result is distinct from the frozen parent.
Minced meat and sliced potato suggest a familiar layered baked main dish. Cooking meat and potatoes, layering and baking are explicit; the mashed-potato route admits an already crafted intermediate.

Uses an already prepared mash as the potato layer with cooked minced meat. The baked layered outcome is distinct from serving plain meat beside mash; explanation supplies that defining transformation.

Maioneză plus an already boiled egg is an immediate appetizer association. Halving, removing yolks, mixing and refilling are explicit; no raw-egg shortcut. Pate is a distinct alternative filling route.

Pate provides a recognizable savory egg filling. The text discloses boiled eggs, yolks and a little mayonnaise rather than asserting two ingredients alone finish the dish. The mayonnaise route remains an equally natural alternative.
Already dried croutons can be crushed into seasoned breadcrumbs. This reuses a former terminal result and preserves its optional seasoning; no stale text or result renaming.

Dry toasted bread plus a crushing tool is a highly inferable route to breadcrumbs. Fully drying and cooling are explicit, so crisp toast is not treated as already dry fine crumbs. New ingredient has onward use.
Pasta plus vegetables gives a familiar complete dish. Boiling then cooling and dressing distinguish this cold salad from the existing hot sauced pasta variants.
Reuses grilled vegetables as a salad component with pasta. The vegetables retain their cooked state and the optional cooling finish is explicit; a clear alternative to the raw vegetable route.
Breadcrumbs and meat identify breaded schnitzel. Thin slices, flour, egg coating and frying are disclosed; new Pesmet joins an existing recognizable result without changing prior shortcuts.

Chicken plus breadcrumbs is a specific and familiar schnitzel route. Preparation explicitly cooks thin chicken slices after flour/egg/crumb coating. The general-meat route broadens entry without arbitrary duplication.

Soup plus thin noodle-shaped pasta is the most direct final pair for noodle soup. One final route is sufficient because both components already have accessible routes; adding an unrelated second pair would weaken the concept. Final explanation must preserve the prepared pasta state.

world_rationale: Independent comparison preserves all 225 old concept records and 294 recipe records exactly; prior quality, final-review and live-audit bindings were checked. Eight familiar starters, 96 later supplies, 12 supply tiers and 32 optional goals remain exact, and all 235 concepts/131 discoveries are reachable. All ten additions are recognizable dishes or ingredients, with nine offering two direct entries. Nine new dishes are terminal, but four prior terminals are reused and Pesmet becomes an intermediate. New explanations disclose heating, filling, cooling or blending rather than pretending two selected items are a complete cooking recipe. The noodle-soup prepared-state inconsistency was reported to the author and its final correction reviewed. New pairs neither overwrite old pairs nor form a noisy universal-combination rule. This is independent editorial quality approval; factual source acceptance and final live-audit acceptance remain separate gates.
